content.title: The UCLA Bruins are national champs! Shop 2026 NCAA championship gear
content.text: Updated April 5, 2026, 8:27 p.m. ETThe UCLA Bruins won their first NCAA women's basketball national championship.UCLA defeated the South Carolina Gamecocks with a final score of 79-51.This championship follows UCLA's Final Four appearances in 2025 and 2026.Official championship merchandise is now available for fans to purchase.UCLA has done it! For the first time, the Bruins are your NCAA women's national champions!UCLA dominated the legendary Dawn Staley and her South Carolina Gamecocks, 79-51 to cut down the nets in Phoenix.SHOP: UCLA 2026 NCAA championship hats, shirts, hoodies, moreIt's been several years in the works for the Bruins, who made it to the Final Four in 2025 and 2026.
